title: Incremental refresh (CDC into the store)
description:
Milestone 3 of the Local Store Initiative: keep the store current without re-mining the world — the store-side twin of the importers' incremental-by-identity discovery. A refresh pass compares each adapter's discover() summaries against stored rows, opens and re-ingests only new or changed sessions, prunes what vanished from the source, and reports per outcome (`IngestReport` — the SkipCounter precedent). Unchanged sessions are never re-opened from their adapters. Turns `06_refresh.feature` green.

Every task in this epic: work in your own worktree off origin/develop (unique path, e.g. /tmp/botspy-<task-id>-<short>), branch `feat/store-<short>`, PR to develop only — never main (GitFlow). Log milestone comments on the task; close only when its DoD is met. Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
